Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results Revenue of $673.8 million and Direct-to-Consumer (“DTC”) Revenue of $275.1 million Revenue Decreased (7.8)% Sequentially and (0.1)% Year Over Year DTC Platforms Revenue Decreased (4.1)% Sequentially and Increased 31.4% Year Over Year Herzliya, Israel - November 5, 2026 - Playtika Holding Corp. (NASDAQ: PLTK) today released financial results for its third quarter for the period ending September 30, 2026. Conclusion of Strategic Review Playtika’s Board of Directors has concluded its review of strategic alternatives and determined that Playtika will continue to operate as an independent, publicly traded company. The Board believes this path best positions the company to create long-term value for shareholders. Financial Highlights • Revenue of $673.8 million decreased (7.8)% sequentially and (0.1)% year over year. • DTC platforms revenue of $275.1 million decreased (4.1)% sequentially and increased 31.4% year over year. • Net Income of $40.4 million and Adjusted Net Income of $120.7 million. • Adjusted EBITDA of $252.1 million increased 22.3% sequentially and 15.9% year over year. • Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $594.6 million as of September 30, 2026. “With the strategic review complete, we are moving forward as an independent company. Our third quarter reflects what makes Playtika durable: loyal players and games built to last,” said Robert Antokol, Chief Executive Officer. “SuperPlay continued to deliver strong year-over-year growth, with Disney Solitaire up 88%, and June’s Journey grew double digits in its ninth year. These results show the resilience of our portfolio.” “We set a plan for 2026, and we are delivering on it. In the third quarter, marketing stepped down as planned, Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 37.4%, and we delivered record quarterly Adjusted EBITDA of $252.1 million, alongside net income of $40.4 million and adjusted net income of $120.7 million,” said Tae Lee, Chief Financial Officer. “We intend to build on that discipline by strengthening our balance sheet.” Selected Operational Metrics and Business Highlights • Average Daily Paying Users of 333K decreased (9.3)% sequentially and (5.9)% year over year. • Average Payer Conversion of 4.7%, up from 4.6% in Q2 2026 and 4.3% in Q3 2025. • Bingo Blitz revenue of $133.0 million decreased (8.3)% sequentially and (18.2)% year over year. • Disney Solitaire revenue of $111.2 million decreased (21.9)% sequentially and increased 88.4% year over year. • June’s Journey revenue of $76.6 million increased 2.4% sequentially and 12.1% year over year. Financial Outlook We are reaffirming our full-year revenue range of $2.75 to $2.85 billion and Adjusted EBITDA range of $750 to $790 million, and we now expect to land around the midpoint of both ranges. Conference Call Playtika management will host a conference call at 5:30 a.m. Pacific Time (8:30 a.m. Eastern Time) today to discuss the company’s results. The conference call can be accessed via a webcast accessible at investors.playtika.com. Playtika (NASDAQ: PLTK) is a mobile gaming entertainment and technology market leader with a portfolio of multiple game titles. Founded in 2010, Playtika was among the first to offer free-to-play social games on social networks and, shortly after, on mobile platforms. Headquartered in Herzliya, Israel, and guided by a mission to entertain the world through infinite ways to play, Playtika has employees across offices worldwide. Our Credit Agreement defines Adjusted EBITDA as net income before (i) interest expense, (ii) interest income, (iii) provision for income taxes, (iv) depreciation and amortization expense, (v) impairment charges, (vi) stock-based compensation, (vii) contingent consideration, (viii) acquisition and related expenses, and (ix) certain other items. We calculate Adjusted EBITDA Margin as Adjusted EBITDA divided by revenues. We define Adjusted Net Income as net income before (i) impairment charges, and (ii) contingent consideration. Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA Margin and Adjusted Net Income as calculated herein may not be comparable to similarly titled measures reported by other companies within the industry and are not determined in accordance with GAAP. Our presentation of Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA Margin and Adjusted Net Income should not be construed as an inference that our future results will be unaffected by unusual or unexpected items.
